scope: Independent structure checks plus provider preview review for ten batch assets; not complete browser or production approval.
limitations: Provider preview is a single rendered view, not proof of every surface or viewing direction.
Inspector confirms the implemented structural and texture decoding checks, not watertightness, production topology, actual dimensions or front direction.
Named part requirements, functional pivots and material separation need postprocessing and browser verification.
